provenance.notes: FDSN event service page read 2026-11-10: no rate limit stated; queries limited to 20,000 events (HTTP 400 beyond); time/area search limits 'being evaluated and not enforced yet'; automated applications should use the real-time GeoJSON feeds whenever possible. Responses send Cache-Control: public, max-age=60 (checked). USGS-authored data are in the U.S. public domain; the USGS asks for a citation such as 'Credit: U.S. Geological Survey' (a request). Contributed network data and the USGS identifier are outside that.
